scope: Source-exact conditional development evidence, left context 8-64 characters, not independent Gold
access: After all nine fixed fits complete; no model selection or threshold changes
models: Frozen Issue-29 plus wiki_small/wiki_large/mixed for each preregistered seed

modes.gated: same argmax only if score minus rank-1 score > 1.7, else original rank 1

prediction_unit: Output surface; candidate-index changes with identical surfaces are not overrides
failures: Keep every fixed row. Missing candidate execution is scored incorrect for all models and reported separately; this is an acquisition-inclusive research metric, not a measurement of production fallback correctness.
recall: rescue / baseline-incorrect rows, including source-target misses
application_to_error: changed surfaces among baseline-incorrect rows / all baseline-incorrect rows

confidence.row_intervals: Wilson 95%; harm additionally exact Clopper-Pearson 95%, with row-independence assumption explicit
confidence.paired_intervals: 10000 full source/input-component bootstrap replicates, fixed PCG64 seed 20261105
confidence.bootstrap_failure: Undefined denominator replicates counted; interval null rather than dropping them
confidence.certification: Intervals do not certify label truth or source independence

comparison_family: For each of two modes: every model versus converter baseline (10); each adapted model versus frozen Issue-29 (9); wiki_large versus wiki_small for each seed (3); mixed versus wiki_large for each seed (3). Total 50 directional accuracy contrasts.
multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment of the complete 50 exact McNemar p-values; row-exchangeability assumption explicit. Paired component intervals reported alongside, without claiming familywise simultaneous intervals.
selection: Report all seeds; do not choose best seed, retrain, or tune after observing these results
